shared_elements: low-relief carving on an upright slab-like surface
headgear or crown on the head
linear incised patterning on the body or garment
justification: Both depict a large single anthropomorphic figure in low relief occupying most of an upright surface, with a headdress and incised surface decoration, and both include disc-like circular motifs. But the specifics diverge sharply: B shows a naturalistically proportioned winged human in profile with detailed feathered wings, fringed garment, bucket and cone beside a stylised tree, while A is a blocky, schematic frontal figure with a broad squared head, abstract oval and circular signs on the torso and no wings, animals, plants or held objects — nothing points to a shared iconographic scheme.
